name: odoo_find_pending_invoices
description:
Find invoices/bills pending payment for a partner.
Uses correct Odoo 18 domains:
state='posted' AND payment_state in ('not_paid','partial').
DO NOT use state='open' - that is Odoo 13 and does NOT exist
in Odoo 18.
Omit partner_id to get ALL pending invoices.

name: odoo_get_invoice_summary
description: Get complete details of a specific invoice (account.move), including lines.

name: odoo_get_model_schema
description:
Retrieve the fields and schema for a given Odoo model
(e.g. 'res.partner'). Very useful if a field search fails.

name: odoo_create_calendar_event
description:
Creates a calendar event (appointment or meeting)
handling multiple attendees automatically.

name: odoo_create_sale_order
description: Creates a sale order (presupuesto) for a customer with product lines.

name: odoo_confirm_sale_order
description: Confirms a sale order, moving it from draft/sent to 'sale' status.

name: odoo_create_lead
description: Creates a new CRM Lead / Opportunity.

name: odoo_get_product_stock
description: Returns stock quantities (on hand, reserved) for a given product.

name: odoo_log_timesheet
description: Logs a timesheet entry for a project or task.

name: odoo_find_attendance
description: Lists attendance entries (hr.attendance) for a user/employee and date range.

name: odoo_log_task_timesheet
description: Logs timesheet hours directly to a task, resolving project_id automatically.

name: odoo_check_in
description: Registers attendance check-in for current user or selected employee.

name: odoo_check_out
description: Registers attendance check-out for current user or selected employee.

name: odoo_register_payment
description: Registers a payment for a specific customer or vendor invoice.
